description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo HTML and return a list of result URLs with titles and snippets. Use this BEFORE fetch_url when the user asks you to 'search', 'find', 'look up', or otherwise discover content — instead of guessing google.com (which always blocks). Pipeline: web_search(query) -> pick relevant results -> fetch_url(result.url, fetch_backend: 'html_requests') on each. Returns up to 20 results.

debug.description: When true, include a debug_html_excerpt in the response for troubleshooting parsing failures.

limit.description: Max results to return. Default 10, max 20.

name: web_search
title: Search the web
